evidence: Parsed by me on the frozen bytes (read-only, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1). (1) Python tomllib loads task/task.toml, task/tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml files with no error; none contains a CR byte, a BOM or a backslash (so no accidental escape inside the triple-quoted descriptions). Each judge.toml has exactly the tables judge, scoring, criterion; criterion counts are render 1, constraints 2, functional 42, polish 6, visual 3 (54 ids, no duplicates, id == name, non-empty description, no keys beyond id/name/type/weight/description/points). prompt_template = "prompt.md" resolves in every suite and each prompt.md carries one {app_context} placeholder that test.sh substitutes from tests/app_context.md, which exists. (2) Shell: `bash -n` succeeds on task/solution/solve.sh and task/tests/test.sh; both start with '#!/bin/bash\n'; a scan of every file under task/ found no CRLF and no BOM. tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/scoring.toml, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/.dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template; task.toml differs from the template only in name, description, keywords, difficulty, difficulty_explanation, category, provenance and arena_slice (timeouts and the [verifier.env] block unchanged). (3) Reference/app entry: `node --check` passes on task/solution/app/server.js (CommonJS, package.json "type": "commonjs"); it requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3, which both images install globally and expose through NODE_PATH, resolves files from __dirname, honours DB_PATH and PORT, and answers GET /api/health before the JSON middleware. The shipped bundle task/solution/app/public/assets/index.js passes `node --check` as an ES module and has no top-level bare import left, so no install or build step is needed at launch; public/index.html references /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, both present; public/runner.html equals static/runner.html. score.py and restart_mcp.py pass ast.parse. environment/assets/seed_data.json, package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json pass json.loads. (4) Actual-run support: projects/colderwater-playground-devtools is identical to the frozen task (diff -rq clean), and the artifact hashes I recomputed for run_golden.sh and the six result JSON files match raw-evidence-index.json. That run installed the app with this solve.sh and launched node /app/server.js as uid 65534 under env -i with DB_PATH, NODE_PATH and a working directory outside /app; results show every scripted criterion true with pageErrors [] and a real process restart keeping revision 2 with history [2, 1]. Limits, stated plainly: that run used the agent image, not tests/test.sh in the verifier image; rewardkit has not loaded these exact judge.toml bytes (the hosted configured-judge run was on an earlier candidate with 41 functional criteria); src/custom-editor.js fails a bare `node --check` only because it is ESM build input for Vite and is never executed by node at runtime, which is not a defect. No broken-app or conforming-alternative scenario applies to a well-formedness row beyond the entry contract (node /app/server.js, port 3000), which test.sh and integration.md state consistently.
